span.p:
Critical
HighAuthFailureRate (5xx > 5% for 5m)
RefreshTokenReuse (rate > 10/min)
AuditChainBreak (verification fails)
DBPoolExhausted (> 95%)
RedisUnavailable (ping fails 30s)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Warning
MFA Lockouts Spike (> 50/5m)
KeyRotationOverdue (> 35 days)
WebhookDeliveryFailing (> 10% for 10m)
ImpossibleTravelDetected

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Context on Every Log
requestId, correlationId
userId, tenantId, sessionId
algorithm (when crypto involved)
